questions.question: Please identify the verified creator or rights holder of the hand-and-ring cover and the basis for its use. The caption calls it an author-created illustration, but source and rights_basis only say “Illustration accompanying the text,” which does not establish authorship.

localizations.source: Please identify the verified creator or rights holder of the hand-and-ring cover and the basis for its use. The caption calls it an author-created illustration, but source and rights_basis only say “Illustration accompanying the text,” which does not establish authorship.
localizations.ru: Уточнить подтверждённого автора или правообладателя обложки с ладонью и кольцом и основание её использования. Сейчас подпись называет изображение авторским, но source и rights_basis содержат только «Иллюстрация к материалу», что не подтверждает авторство.

questions.question: The algorithm is explicitly identified as a mathematical recreation from L. F. Magnitsky’s Arithmetic, but the root authors and rights_basis attribute the material entirely to Mansur Gilmullin. Distinguish the historical source and authorship of Magnitsky’s recreation from Mansur’s modern adaptation or editing.
